notes.title: About future updates
notes.content:
It's been a week since the release.
We would like to take this opportunity to thank many people for playing!

Now, I would like to explain the policy for future updates.
In the future. We are planning the following updates.

[list]
[*] Addition of a wandering girl (currently it is difficult to obtain achievements related to obtaining some items, so we would like to alleviate this)
[*] Addition of corridor and dream transformation
[*] Existing corridors, setting of enemy thoughts in dream transformation
[*] Balance adjustment (especially ability changes)
[*] English translation and Chinese translation (from UI for now)
[*] Adding map terrain
[*] Reconsidering the map design (because it would be a boring landscape if it was all walls)
[*] Implementing profiles
[*] Create achievement icons properly (This is strictly a matter of Steam operation rather than a game update)
[/list]

However, I would like to prioritize preparations for the Hakurei Shrine Festival until May 3rd, so I may not update much during April.
At the Hakurei Shrine annual festival, we will be holding a circle at Ka26a "Daikichi-za" and will be distributing a collection of game standing pictures and acrylic figures.
As of April 14th, we are looking for adult women to work as salespeople, so please check T.D's Twitter for details.
There are a lot of things I want to do after May, so I'll update slowly while doing them.
Thank you very much for your understanding.

notes.title: Ver1.00 official release
notes.content:
Today, April 8, 2024, the day of the flower festival, we officially released "Touhou Suijin Kairou".
It's been 5 years since the release of the early access version, and about 7 years including the development period, and various things have happened both in game development and in real life.
However, I was able to continue development without giving up or giving up, and I'm overwhelmed with emotion that I was finally able to officially release it.
We hope you will enjoy this work, which took seven years to develop, and features over 150 fantasy girls, and a profound and branching story that involves the entire Gensokyo and other worlds!
Even after the official release, it's completely free and you can carry over all the data from the early access version!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34316768/82f0244acce515c6673fc7da2dd6aa66908de9db.png[/img]

Updates from the beta version are as follows.

[list]
[*] Unlock the entire story (the volume will not be doubled but more than tripled)
[*] Added some wandering girls
[*] Added an effect that affects map exploration to help specific to wandering girls.
[*] Specifications have been changed for the effects of map exploration using map mechanisms and help unique to wandering girls.
[*] Renovated the gift-giving screen
[*] Other bug fixes and balance adjustments
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support of Touhou Suijin Kairou!

notes.title: About the game release date
notes.content:
Long time no see.
This is T.D.

It's been about a year since the last update, but we're finally on track for a full release of the game!
The goal is to release it by May 2024. (Probably released in April)
In May, there will be the Hakurei Shrine Reitaisai, a major event in the Touhou region, and we are continuing to develop it in time for it.
In addition, at the annual festival, we plan to distribute a collection of setting materials containing rough sketches of the work's "Yugen no Hana".

[h1]Developmental status[/h1]
Regarding the game, we are currently mainly developing the following.
[h2]story[/h2]
There will be over 100 episodes in total, which is more than 5 times the volume of the current version!
This is a profound story where the story branches out in complex ways depending on your choices.
The choices you make in a story have a big impact on other stories, and due to this complex specification, we have not been able to update it until now.
Currently, more than 90% of the story has been written, and the remaining work is scheduled to be completed in a month or two.

[h2]balance adjustment[/h2]
We are making adjustments to the balance of the story and current anomalies.
We will do this for about two months until May 2024.

[h2]Addition of corridor functions[/h2]
Various functions have been added to the corridor.
There are various light sources, gimmick objects, etc.
We will do this for about one month until May 2024.

[h1]lastly[/h1]
This work, which has been in development for several years, is finally in sight!
We will continue to develop it to make it the best game possible.
We occasionally report on the game's development status on Twitter ( https://twitter.com/TD12734 ).
Please follow me if you like. (Please be careful as I sometimes retweet erotic images)
We also plan to announce the game at https://twitter.com/TD_12734.
I only tweet things that can be seen by all ages.
Please follow us if you like.

Sorry for the long message.
Thank you for your continued support.

tags.balance_change: We are making adjustments to the balance of the story and current anomalies.

tags.feature: Various functions have been added to the corridor.
There are various light sources, gimmick objects, etc.
